name: UV Protection Sunglasses
description: Stylish UV400 protection sunglasses perfect for summer outings. Lightweight frame with polarized lenses that reduce glare and protect your eyes from harmful UV rays. Available in multiple colors.

name: SPF 50 Sunscreen Lotion
description: Dermatologist-tested SPF 50 sunscreen lotion that protects your skin from UVA and UVB rays. Water-resistant formula lasts up to 8 hours. Lightweight, non-greasy, and suitable for all skin types.

name: Tropical Beach Shirt
description: Breezy tropical print beach shirt made from 100% breathable cotton. Perfect for beach days, vacations, and summer parties. Machine washable and available in sizes S to XXL.

name: Waterproof Beach Bag
description: Spacious waterproof beach bag with multiple compartments. Fits towels, sunscreen, snacks, and more. Made from durable, sand-resistant material with a comfortable shoulder strap. Perfect for a full beach day.

name: Aloe Vera After-Sun Gel
description: Soothing 99% pure aloe vera gel that calms and cools sun-exposed skin. Helps reduce redness and prevents peeling after a day in the sun. Alcohol-free, fragrance-free, and safe for sensitive skin.

name: Foldable Sun Hat
description: Wide-brim foldable sun hat that provides full face and neck protection. Made from lightweight straw material with a UPF 50+ rating. Packable and travel-friendly — fits easily in any beach bag.

name: Inflatable Pool Float
description: Giant inflatable pool float in a fun flamingo design. Made from thick, puncture-resistant PVC. Easy to inflate and deflate. Supports up to 200 lbs. Great for pools, lakes, and calm ocean shores.

name: Summer Flip Flops
description: Comfortable and durable rubber flip flops with arch support and anti-slip soles. Perfect for the beach, pool, or casual summer walks. Available in 6 vibrant summer colors and sizes 5–13.
